description: Returns one launch by slug: its property type (condo or ec, which adds a notice on executive condominiums), its reviewed facts with source and page, the price statement with its kind and date, and the gaps the material leaves open. Prices are guidance from developer price lists: indicative before launch, reset on booking day, and subject to promotions afterwards. Treat them as a starting point and confirm with the agent. Every answer carries its source, the date it was reviewed, the stage of the launch, and the agent's licence details. Anything the developer material does not settle is returned as a gap with the question to ask, never as a guess.

slug.description: The launch slug, as returned by list_launches
